name: A Delver's Charm
description: Retrieve Cave Bat wings for Willowbrook's superstitious miners.

dialogue.offer: Our miners swear three Cave Bat Wings woven together ward off cave-ins. Could you fetch them?
dialogue.in_progress: The Cavern east of Meadow is thick with bats. I still need three wings.
dialogue.ready: Perfect. The miners will descend with steadier hands tomorrow.
dialogue.completed: Your charm hangs above the mine entrance now.
